case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for explaining your cost structure alongside the quotation. We recognise that rising alloy and processing costs put pressure on your pricing, and appreciate your transparency.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

Our analysis supports the proposed pricing within a longer agreement, giving your pricing committee a clear package with greater revenue predictability. We are flexible on payment terms, with Option B retaining your quoted terms; please indicate which package works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.21 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our relationship with Werdenfels and welcome your consideration of these packages.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We appreciate your transparency and are open to a 24-month agreement to provide greater predictability for both parties. However, for a contract of this length, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material volatility. With this adjustment and maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. This proposal is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for reducing your price and clarifying the material share. We understand that the verified delivery record does not change your cost calculation, and recognise your need for protection against alloy volatility.

We have modestly raised our offer and are flexible on indexation: Option B gives you the alloy index clause you requested in exchange for a lower base price. The longer agreement offers predictable business under either option; please indicate which structure works best and whether you can reciprocate our price movement.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.33 per unit, fixed price, no index clause, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.28 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive approach and look forward to your response.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We appreciate your willingness to include the AS-14404 index clause, which is essential for a 24-month contract. Therefore, we must hold our offer at €5.60 per unit for this package. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

As your distributor, we remain committed to serving your needs with our broad product range and dedicated service. We look forward to continuing our collaboration.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for the price reduction and for clarifying your position on the package. We recognise that protection against alloy movements is essential to your longer agreement.

We have modestly raised our offer and ask you to reciprocate on price, with the longer commitment providing predictable business. We remain flexible on indexation: Option A fixes the price, while Option B gives you the alloy index clause you requested in exchange for a lower base price; please indicate which works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.39 per unit, fixed price, no index clause, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.34 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your openness on costs and would welcome an agreement that keeps our relationship commercially worthwhile.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We are presenting our Angebot with a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We are willing to accept the 5% deadband on the AS-14404 index clause as proposed in your Option B. To balance the risk of absorbing this initial material volatility, we must trade the payment terms to 30 days net. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.70 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
